# LocalPilot

> {{ site.description }}

LocalPilot is a free, MIT-licensed Visual Studio Code extension (`{{ site.extension_id }}`, version {{ site.version }}, requires VS Code 1.104 or later). It is a coding agent that runs against local model servers: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM, colibri, Docker Model Runner, Jan, SGLang, KoboldCpp, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Code and prompts go only to the model servers the user configures, which default to localhost. The extension has no account and sends no telemetry; usage metrics stay in local files. Local models are weaker than frontier cloud models, and the model must fit in the machine's memory.

Features:
- Agent, Ask and Plan modes with approvals for terminal, write, delete and network actions.
- Parallel agents, each in an isolated git worktree (`localpilot.worktrees.mode`), with per-agent change review; pause, steer or stop each agent and subagent lane; Best-of-N runs one task on several models to compare.
- 14 built-in skills and 9 built-in subagents (clarifier, explore, planner, coder, tester, debugger, reviewer, docs, researcher). Skills in the Agent Skills `SKILL.md` format install from GitHub or a URL, and catalog skills can install themselves when a request matches.
- Automatic model setup: with no model found it installs or starts Ollama and downloads a small starter set sized to the machine. A model manager and model gallery show what fits, install, enable, disable and remove models.
- Automatic routing: images go to a vision model, inline completions to the smallest FIM-capable model, Plan mode to `localpilot.routing.reasoning` when set, with fallback when a model is offline.
- Usage-based model tuning (`localpilot.models.autoTune`: auto, suggest or off): learns from the last 14 days of local metrics per model and role (speed, time to first token, finished runs, errors, completion acceptance) and adjusts routing. In `auto` it can switch role settings to a measurably better installed model, with guardrails and Undo. Command: LocalPilot: Tune Models From Usage.
- colibri support (github.com/JustVugg/colibri): runs very large mixture-of-experts models such as GLM-5.2 or DeepSeek V4 Flash on 16 GB or more of RAM by streaming experts from disk. Memory fit uses the RAM-resident size. Disk-streamed models are slow (minutes of prefill, about 1 token/s), so LocalPilot keeps them for Plan mode and away from subagents and inline completions. Command: LocalPilot: Start colibri.
- Screenshots and vision models, inline completions, MCP servers, @-mentions and workspace context, a local Dashboard, a Markdown reader, a `localpilot` CLI for the terminal, and live tokens per second in the chat.
- Claude Code compatibility: reads CLAUDE.md (with @imports), AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .claude/skills, .claude/agents, .claude/commands, plugins, settings.json permission rules and hooks.
- The chat can live in either side bar, the panel or an editor tab. Local models also appear in VS Code's Language Model API, so Copilot Chat can use them.

Install: VS Code Marketplace {{ site.marketplace }} or `code --install-extension {{ site.extension_id }}`. VSIX downloads: {{ site.releases }}. Source: {{ site.repo }}. Author: {{ site.author.name }} ({{ site.author.url }}).
